arguments.message: Yes – you can set up a scheduled export that automatically saves each run to your cloud storage. Go to **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**, pick the data you want, choose a recurrence (daily, weekly, or monthly), and connect your cloud storage provider via the one‑time OAuth connection.
